notes: Perso dubbing can target every language Perso offers, 77 in all, with regional variants such as English (UK) and Portuguese (Portugal).
While AI packs download, the dialog shows the percent; Hide moves it to the top bar until you bring it back.
Subtitled exports match the work screen's size, and export again after an update changed how they are drawn.
Windows updates install without the setup wizard, and the pre-update check reads correctly in Korean.
A download that was interrupted says so and resumes where it left off when you press Download and Start.
